removedOrChanged.text: The aim of this guide is to provide a basic overview of how to get consistent kills at Amascut, the Devourer. Due to the boss' high defence levels, demanding DPS checks and mechanical complexity, contents of this guide assume you have at least made it to the end of Stage 1 of Upgrade guides for your chosen style. As Amascut is enrage-based with fixed enrages of 100, 500, 750, 1000, 2000 and 4000%, mechanics and strategies may differ based on enrage. For the purposes of this guide, 100% enrage will be utilized.

Amascut, Goddess of Destruction

This guide is made and upkept in collaboration with the Amascut, Goddess of Destruction (external Discord) discord.

​
Content provided by: Loki & Linie
 Content maintained by: Loki
​
Amascut, Goddess of Destruction is a community focused on high-quality matchmaking, structured learner support, and building a strong, drama-free PvM community.
